meta.caveat: This carrier runs the other way from most: its content is the MATE competency catalog (mate-rov.json) and the standards are what each competency draws on. A strength is how fully that standard describes what the competency asks of a team, not how well anything we teach covers it. Where one standard is cited by several competencies the entry's own strength is the weakest among them, and by_locator keeps each competency's own strength and reason. Applied rule: one to three core standards per competency, no 'related'. All of it is this project's own reading of the manuals, adopted from drafts you did not review line by line; the Stage 4 audit is where it gets a real review.
